## overlap testing with ANGORA nominated AD gene therapeutic target

```{r}
#| echo: false

#library
library(tidyverse)
library(openxlsx)


#set path
source_path="G:/My Drive/Bakulski Lab/Projects/CTD-Dementia/Alz&Dem resubmit 2026/"

#data
angora <- read.csv(paste0(source_path, "gene_list_ANGORA_june92026.csv"))
ctd <- read.xlsx(paste0(source_path,"CTD_supplemental_table2_10.7.25.xlsx"), startRow = 2, colNames = TRUE)

```

```{r}
angora <- angora %>% arrange(angora)
```

```{r}
head(angora)
```

```{r}
###make upset plot!                                                        
angora.AD<- intersect(angora$Gene.Symbol, ctd$Alzheimers.disease)            #35 --> 70
angora.er<- intersect(angora$Gene.Symbol, ctd$ER.stress)                     #19 --> 329  
angora.isr<- intersect(angora$Gene.Symbol, ctd$Integrated.stress.response)   #2  --> 51
angora.mca<- intersect(angora$Gene.Symbol, ctd$microglial.cell.activation)   #18 --> 52
angora.nid<- intersect(angora$Gene.Symbol, ctd$neuroinflammatory.diseases)   #8  --> 25
angora.pd<- intersect(angora$Gene.Symbol, ctd$proteostatsis.deficencies)     #20 --> 107
angora.rup<- intersect(angora$Gene.Symbol, ctd$Response.to.unfolded.protein) #9  --> 170
angora.tau<- intersect(angora$Gene.Symbol, ctd$Tauopathies)                  #38 --> 73
angora.tdp<- intersect(angora$Gene.Symbol, ctd$TDP.proteinopathies)          #15 --> 97




```
